plan.exclusive_partition: each hardware stack assigned once; interrupt first, lock, read, CRC, LZ4 reset/body, plan, pack, publish, other; no sum of overlapping wall clocks
scope_limits: BPF probe overhead is included; not exact uninstrumented owner CPU
hardware cycles are not converted into nanoseconds
unresolved function symbols, missing END, overlaps or lost events invalidate attribution
same-source previous untraced three-pair diagnostic is context only; >10% mean normalized throughput shift flags intrusive profiling, not a code regression
plan.setup_correction: First capture technically invalid: stale module symbols. Preserved unresolved logs; collect exactly three replacement pairs with raw IP stacks plus live module section snapshots. Root UID gate excludes build-time regular-file contracts.
plan.workqueue_scope: sched_switch-clipped workqueue function intervals within GO/read exit through final fsync; includes IRQ/softirq execution on owner task

qualification: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY: all three raw-repeat screens NOISY (14.1% spread); no performance keep/remove conclusion
scope: IRQ-inclusive scheduled work-function time; not exact uninstrumented CPU. Categories are exclusive hardware-cycle samples, not nanosecond partitions.
symbols: raw IP resolved from live module section snapshots plus exact module ELF; no unresolved module frames
